title: Querying the Database | Using SQL | InterSystems IRIS Data Platform 2026.1

examples.sql: SELECT Name,DOB FROM Sample.Person WHERE Name %STARTSWITH 'A' ORDER BY DOB
SELECT Interns FROM (SELECT Name AS Interns FROM Sample.Employee WHERE Age<21) WHERE Interns %STARTSWITH 'A'

SELECT P.Home_City,P.Home_Zip AS FakeZip,Z.ZipCode,Z.City AS ZipCity,Z.State FROM Sample.Person AS P LEFT OUTER JOIN Sample.USZipCode AS Z ON P.Home_Zip=Z.ZipCode WHERE Z.ZipCode IS NOT NULL ORDER BY P.Home_City
CREATE QUERY Sample.AgeQuery(IN topnum INT DEFAULT 10,IN minage INT 20) PROCEDURE BEGIN SELECT TOP :topnum Name,Age FROM Sample.Person WHERE Age > :minage ORDER BY Age ; END
SELECT Name,FavoriteColors FROM Sample.Person WHERE FOR SOME %ELEMENT(FavoriteColors) (%Value = 'Red')
SELECT Name,FavoriteColors FROM Sample.Person WHERE FOR SOME %ELEMENT(Sample.Person.FavoriteColors) (%Value IN ('Red', 'Blue', 'Green'))
